package rulefixtures

import (
	"io"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for init_side_effect: init() functions that perform network, file-system, or subprocess side effects.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: idioms; severity: info.
var scenario387PositiveData []byte

func init() {
	resp, err := http.Get("https://example.com/config.json")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	data, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	scenario387PositiveData = data
}
